info.name: WooCommerce REST Cart Tax Rates API

params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection. Defaults to 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items per page. Defaults to 10, maximum 100.

params.name: class
params.description: Filter tax rates by tax class slug. Options: standard, reduced-rate, zero-rate, or any custom class slug.

items.docs: Returns all configured tax rates. Supports filtering by tax class and ordering by priority, order, or ID.
